description: "#{Box.new(2)}" where Box defines its own `to_s` -- interpolation *dispatches*. This is `pkg_version.rb`'s `"#{version}_#{revision}"` exactly, and it is why `__as_string` cannot be a plain builtin row: on a user instance it has to reach the class's own `to_s` through the MRO, and fall back to the default only if there is none.
